definitions.gloss: broadcast reception fee; NHK license fee
definitions.explanation: The fee that households with a television must pay to the public broadcaster NHK under the Broadcasting Act. Collecting it, and whether people should have to pay it, is a long-running public issue.

examples.japanese: {受信料|じゅしんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
NHK⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受信料|じゅしんりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ}→口座振替：19853_kouzafurikae⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I pay my NHK fee by bank transfer.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていない→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{受信料|じゅしんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集金|しゅうきん}→集金：20644_shuukin⟧{係|がかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't even own a TV, but a fee collector came to my house and I didn't know what to do.

notes:
Payment is based on a ⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (reception contract), which the law requires anyone with a TV to sign, though there is no criminal penalty for not paying.
